frame.origin: the leeward face of the tree belt at ground level, on the vertical section through the belt's centre (MP_caseG.png)
frame.x: +x downwind: the belt occupies x in [-2, 0] m and the measurement lines lie behind it at x = 1.75 ... 35 m
frame.y: +y along the belt (74 m long, y in [-37, 37]); every point is on y = 0, the centre section
frame.z: +z up from the ground; the belt spans z in [1.2, 7] (1.2 m bottom gap); points at z = 1.5, 3, 4.5, 6 m
frame.wind_direction_rotation: single direction: the wind blows toward +x (perpendicular to the belt); the field angle is not published
frame.length_scale: FULL-scale metres: a field observation, no model

files.format: ASCII STL, LF, metres, same frame as points.csv
files.source: generated from the readme's stated dimensions (74 m along y, 2 m along x, 7 m high, 1.2 m bottom gap), centred on y = 0 with its leeward face at x = 0 (MP_caseG.png). A porous canopy: the data paper gives a shading rate of 81 % after pruning (section 3.7); the box is its envelope
